source.title: A survey of some open problems on p_n-sequences and free spectra of algebras and varieties

trace.notes: Normalized the input as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/139648 for document identifier 139648. Local shard metadata identified the exact work as George Gratzer and Andrzej Kisielewicz's 1992 chapter 'A survey of some open problems on p_n-sequences and free spectra of algebras and varieties'.

Failure mode: network_or_dns_failure plus metadata_only. Local shell fetches of https://zbmath.org/139648, https://zbmath.org/?q=an:139648, and the zbMATH API endpoint failed because outbound DNS is unavailable in the sandbox. Browser resolution of the exact zbMATH URL did not expose a readable record body or full-text artifact, so zbMATH was treated only as a bibliographic resolver.

trace.notes: Identifier-specific recovery established additional metadata for the same work: Zbl 0772.08001, MR1191227, published in 'Universal Algebra and Quasigroup Theory' by Heldermann Verlag in 1992, pages 57-88. These metadata records and citation pages did not provide readable full text.

trace.notes: Bounded exact-work recovery used exact-title, exact-title plus PDF, and Zbl/MR identifier searches. Candidate pages from AMS, ScienceDirect, Cambridge Core, EuDML, DML-CZ, ResearchGate, and the zbMATH author profile were rejected because they were references, citation metadata, author-profile metadata, related papers, or search snippets rather than the same work's readable technical text containing the open-problem statements.
No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the chapter's open-problem statements was recovered.

The source-adequacy gate forbids extracting questions from zbMATH metadata, local shard metadata, citation/reference pages, search snippets, or related papers. The run therefore remains in needs_review with accepted empty.
